item.title: Self-Hosted Peppol Access Points in 2026: phoss-AP vs Oxalis-NG vs Mustangproject
item.description: Europe is quietly deleting the paper invoice. Germany already requires every B2B supplier to be able to receive structured e-invoices, France’s clearance mandate is rolling out, Belgium’s B2B obligation starts in January 2026 and Poland’s KSeF platform goes live in phases through 2026. If you run an ERP, an accounting tool, or an internal billing service, the question is no longer whether you need structured invoicing — it is whether you rent a SaaS access point forever or self-host the plumbing.
